rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 平成２３年度総合防災訓練, dated 1 September 2011, says that on that day all ministers, led by 菅総理, took part in the comprehensive disaster-prevention drill, and that after the emergency disaster headquarters meeting 菅総理 held the drill's Prime Minister's press conference.
